description: An unnamed `if` nested inside a nested `dynamic` merges its branch's effects directly into the parent's own namespace (transparent control); a later step in that same chain reads the branch's tool output through `{from: prime.outer.inner.step.value}`, which must see the write live -- the interpreter's own live-context rule (deep-copying the enclosing scope per render, not a once-per-run snapshot), not a value frozen at container-entry time (electricity/DESIGN.md §6.3, §6.7; issue #442's interpreter-cost note).
